project.name: 在呀 ZÀIYA 官网
project.designRead: Competition landing / Judges & evaluators / warm professional trust / medium density / avoid cold tech or cartoonish style
project.styleDefinitionBrief: Youth mental health AI companion landing, warm amber/cream palette inspired by Bend Health, generous whitespace, Chinese-first typography, IP mascot as memory anchor

typographySystem.body: Noto Sans SC, PingFang SC, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif

styleContinuityAnchors.colorTone: warm amber/cream with sage green secondary
styleContinuityAnchors.surfaceDepthModel: border-first static surfaces, shadow only for floating layers

pages.title: 在呀 ZÀIYA 首页
pages.visualNorthStar: Long-scroll landing with 8 distinct sections, each with clear visual separation through alternating warm/cool backgrounds. IP mascot '在在' appears in Hero and scenario sections as a floating companion element.
pages.compositionPattern: Vertical narrative scroll: Hero (split) → Problem definition (cards) → Crisis framing (3-card) → Mechanism (3-layer tabs) → Scenarios (4-card grid) → Differentiation (4-card) → Value/Prospect (text+cards) → Team+Research (cards+report list)
continuityAnchors: Header: fixed nav with logo + section links, warm cream bg
Footer: white bg, multi-column links, copyright
CTA: pill-shaped warm amber buttons throughout
Cards: white bg, 12px radius, light border, subtle shadow on hover
Typography: serif display for section titles, sans-serif body
